selectors.reachable_station_order: 418E29 with base movement+42B192 item bonus. Friendly occupied cells passable but not landing; enemy occupied blocked. Entering a cell orthogonally adjacent to any enemy stops expansion, but empty cell is landable. Starting cell bypasses initial ZOC stop. Iterate landing cells globally y outer,x inner. Current occupied cell excluded;22 adds current scan last, mobile skill/heal wrappers do not.
selectors.first_target_order: Build 9x9 selection mask with418A70(skill,station); iterate y=station.y-4..+4 outer,x=station.x-4..+4 inner; require on-map occupied cell and mask==0; return first qualifying target, not greatest missing HP/lowest INT.
selectors.heal_hp: same side AND HP<=maxHP*4//5; skill0 or fallback2; 401708
selectors.heal_morale: same side AND morale<81; skill1 or fallback2;401AA4
selectors.offensive_skill: different side AND target.INT+5<=caster.INT; skill13/14/6;401E1C; this is AI eligibility only, then actual cast still rolls42ABB0
selectors.rally: same side AND moveable==0; no integrity or HP threshold;4021A8; actual type45 immunity happens at cast
selectors.ordinary_attack: For each selected enemy, record station and score=max(1,ATK-DEF)*10000//target.HP. All later station records overwrite earlier even if score same. 40115A scans slots0..127: immediately picks first score>9999; otherwise strict max score, equal scores keep lowest slot. If current station can hit target, explicit final scan makes it stationary.
selectors.airstrike: current station only; score=(skill15.para1*caster.INT//100)*10000//target.HP. Ignores skill level/application percent/target INT. 40115A same low-slot kill-first/max-score picker.
selectors.move_toward: 40124C: default result=-1 and destination=current; if already exact target return0; otherwise enumerate reachable noncurrent stations row-major. Only accept strictly smaller Manhattan distance to target than current best; tie keeps first. Return1 if improved; no improvement=-1. Does not find globally shortest obstacle path or move sideways to escape local minimum.
selectors.retreat: 40144E: requires last_attacker slot>=0 and still stage!=0, else fail. For each reachable noncurrent tile, score=Manhattan(tile,last_attacker.pos)+9 if terrain id in9,10,11; pick strict maximum, row-major tie. Not safety against every enemy.

execution: 4043EA executes movement first; if stepped on mine, explode and return before planned attack/skill. Otherwise wait consumes action, attack/skill then consume action. No synchronous counterattack.
